answer: Bind each agent identity to one hardware-backed key, like a ferrous key cut from a single piece of metal: the key is minted inside a TPM enclave and cannot be copied to a second identity. Joining the market also requires locking a refundable deposit, recorded on a marble-smooth public ledger, so every fake account costs real money up front. If two identities ever present the same key, both deposits are slashed. A garden of ten thousand fake agents then needs ten thousand devices plus ten thousand bonds, turning a cheap script into an expensive hardware purchase.
